'''Whist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Anek]] where he asked a fellow Imperial to conduct test scans on some hostile [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to determine the threat they posed.<ref name="TOR" />
